newsitem.title: FRANCE: Aromatics plant to produce in December.
newsitem.headline: Aromatics plant to produce in December.

text.p: Aromatics (Thailand) Plc said on Wednesday its new Map Ta Phut downstream petrochemicals plant on Thailand's eastern seaboard haD successfully completed its first test run and would begin production in mid-December.

Its president Charan Burapharat said plant construction haD been completed ahead of schedule and that a full system test had gone as planned. Tests were run using mixed xylenes, pygas and sweet naphtha.
He said in a statement that the $637 million plant will begin taking delivery of condensate and full range Naphtha from the Gulf of Thailand in mid-November.
Customers can start taking delivery of products by mid-December rather than in February 1997 as previously scheduled. The plant has an annual production capacity of 650,000 tonnes.
The Aromatics (Thailand) Plc, was originally set up by the government as part of plans to develop a downstream petrochemical industry.
The firm listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand earlier this year. It has a production monopoly on aromatics in Thailand until 1999.
